rules.label: Financially Indigent (income <= 250% FPL)
rules.quote: Patients may only be granted classification as Financially Indigent if their yearly income as set forth on the Financial Assistance Application is less than or equal to 250% of the poverty guidelines

rules.label: Medically Indigent Catastrophic (income > 500% FPL, bill > 50% income)
rules.quote: The patient's remaining bill must be greater than 50% of the patient's income, and the patient's income must be greater than 500% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines.

notes: Policy applies to patients admitted to the hospital, visiting the RHC, or having outpatient visits including through the emergency room.
Family size calculation differs for adults (patient, spouse, dependents) vs minors (patient, mother, mother's dependents, father, father's dependents).
Income calculation: adults include patient and spouse; minors include patient, mother, and father.
Income verification can use documentation (W-2, pay stubs, tax returns, bank statements, employer verification) or proof of participation in public benefit programs (Medicaid, SNAP, WIC, etc.).
If documentation unavailable, hospital may accept written or verbal attestation after documenting efforts to obtain documentation.
Deminimus accounts (<= $500) may be verified with patient attestation and documentation of two attempts to obtain documentation.
Expired patients may be deemed to have no income; documentation not required.
Hospital may consider other financial assets, liabilities, family income, and ability to pay in determination.
Falsification of information may result in denial or revocation of charity care.
If qualified for other charity programs (CICP, Hospital Discount Care), this application will not be considered for additional discounts or balance adjustments.
Physician services (e.g., ER physicians) may be billed separately and are not covered by this policy.
Application must be returned to Hospital Financial Counselor at 410 Benedicta Avenue, Trinidad, CO 81082.
Assistance available Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. at (719) 845-4251.

dropped.quote: To be considered for classification as a Medically Indigent patient, the amount owed by the patient after payment by all third-party payers must exceed ten percent (10%) of the patient's income and the patient must be unable to pay the remaining bill. The patient's income must be equal to or less than 500% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines.

Proof of participation in any of the above programs indicates that the patient has been deemed financially indigent and therefore, is not required to provide his or her yearly income on the Financial Assistance Application.

rules.label: Financially Indigent
rules.quote: Patients may only be granted classification as Financially Indigent if their yearly income as set forth on the Financial Assistance Application is less than or equal to 250% of the poverty guidelines updated annually in the Federal Register by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services ("Federal Poverty Guidelines").

notes: Applications remain on file for 365 days.
For minors, household includes patient, mother, father, and their dependents.
Income verification may include public benefit program participation, written/verbal attestation, or documentation efforts for deminimus accounts (<=$500).
Expired patients may be deemed to have no income; income documentation not required.
If patient has ability to pay, reassessment possible upon additional documentation.
Falsification may result in denial or revocation of charity care.
If qualified for other charity programs (CICP or Hospital Discount Care Program), this application will not be considered for additional discounts or balance adjustments.
